nodes.label: Codel share image (og.png)
nodes.description: 1200x630 Open Graph / social share card. A flat, near-black charcoal ground with a faint green cast (the --bg #101411) fills the whole frame. A single white uppercase 'CODEL' wordmark sits dead centre, about half the frame wide, with wide empty margins on every side. The letterforms are heavy, geometric and leaning forward: C and O join into one continuous linked shape, the D has an angled notch, the E is built from three separate parallel slanted bars, and the L ends in a slanted cut. No tagline, no Arabic text, no lime accent, no photography: a pure logo-on-ground card.
nodes.rationale: Gives link previews (WhatsApp, social, chat apps) a branded, legible thumbnail using only the approved white logo on the dark brand ground, so no logo recolouring or extra copy is needed. Rendered once with headless Chrome; must be re-rendered the same way if the logo or --bg changes.
